root_cause: Pour integrity failure on /SENSEC2_LO (two islands, foreign_cross=10) fragments the sense copper, causing structural DRC violations and likely contributing to conductor over-temp on sense nets. The FEM flags indicate thermal stress on /SENSEC1_HI, /SENSEC1_LO, GND, and +5VSB, with max_T=120.5°C. The root cause is routing of foreign signals through the sense corridor, which the corridor-avoid lever should address.
reasoning: The primary gate failure is structural DRC=30, driven by the clipped pour on /SENSEC2_LO. kelvin_ok=true means no stranded sense net, so placement actuator T0 will not fire. The deterministic corridor-avoid lever fires from pour_clipped_nets and can route offending foreign signals around the sense corridor. Routing class is appropriate because more/better routing (via corridor-avoid and increased router effort) can close the DRC and improve thermal performance.

proposed_lever.action: Route foreign signals crossing /SENSEC2_LO around the sense corridor to restore pour integrity and reduce DRC violations.
